description: This file defines classes and functions for creating and managing SSL server sockets within the Chromium project, including SSL handshake handling, context creation, and configuration with certificates and private keys.

classes.name: SSLServerSocket
classes.description: An interface for an SSL server socket capable of performing SSL handshakes.

classes.name: SSLServerContext
classes.description: An interface for creating SSL server sockets over existing transport sockets.

methods.name: SSLServerSocket::Handshake
methods.description: Performs the SSL server handshake asynchronously.

methods.name: SSLServerContext::CreateSSLServerSocket
methods.description: Creates an SSL server socket over a connected transport socket.

methods.name: CreateSSLServerContext
methods.description: Creates an SSL server context with specified certificate and private key, sharing session cache.
